fato_historico: 1923: The German government calls off the passive resistance to the French and Belgian occupation of the Ruhr.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to release lingering tensions, much like a long-awaited resolution to a season of resistance. You may find that shifting your approach brings unexpected relief and clarity. It is a good time to abandon outdated battles and embrace a path of gentle progress. Consider letting your natural, vibrant energy lead you toward peaceful new beginnings.
frase_do_dia: Soft hearts can achieve what rigid strength often fails to secure.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of balance and harmonious new cycles.
conselho: Choose to let go of old grudges; peace is your greatest victory.
